blocks.value: Today, opening a Demat and Trading Account usually takes less than 30 minutes and can be completed online.
Imagine This: Opening a new bank account can now be done using your mobile phone. Stock brokers have made investing just as simple.
Most brokers require your PAN card, Aadhaar card, bank account, mobile number, email address and a cancelled cheque or bank proof.
After completing eKYC and verification, your account is activated and ready for investing.
Always use your own PAN, bank account and mobile number while opening your investment account.
